metadata.title: Sara Kitchen
metadata.description: Persian homemade food in Porto, Portugal.

home.title: Sara Kitchen is getting ready to serve you.
home.description: This multilingual foundation is ready for the menu, ordering experience, and management panel.

menu.title: Our menu
menu.description: Explore Persian dishes prepared at home with fresh ingredients.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: Join Sara Kitchen to get ready for ordering. We won't reveal whether a contact is already registered.
signup.passwordHint: Use a passphrase of at least 15 characters.
signup.terms: I agree to the terms and privacy policy
signup.accepted: If these details are eligible, your account is ready. You can sign in when customer sign-in is available.
signup.validationError: Please check your details and try again.
signup.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
signup.networkError: We couldn't complete your request. Please try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Access your Sara Kitchen profile and orders.
login.persistent: Keep me signed in on this device
login.network: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your mobile number or email. If an eligible account exists, we'll text a reset link to its mobile number.
forgotPassword.accepted: If an eligible account exists, a reset link will be sent by SMS.
forgotPassword.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
forgotPassword.error: We couldn't process your request. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.description: Choose a new passphrase. Your reset link expires after 15 minutes and can be used once.
resetPassword.success: Password changed. All previous sessions have been signed out.
resetPassword.invalid: This reset link is invalid, expired, or already used.
resetPassword.error: We couldn't reset your password. Please try again.

shell.signOutFailed: We couldn't sign you out. Please try again.
